map_note: County boards' own data runs ahead of the state's daily dashboard; where a county's figure is higher, it is used. Clermont, Crawford, Franklin, Morrow and Trumbull publish voter-level lists that include each voter's party, so their party splits are used too. Cuyahoga reports totals only, so the extra ballots count in totals but not party shares. Clermont (as of 2026-10-12 15:58): mail returned 531 (state 66); early in person 3,174 (state 2,623). Crawford (as of 2026-10-12 15:47): mail returned 125 (state 18); early in person 624 (state 532). Cuyahoga (as of 2026-10-12 16:00): mail returned 6,984 (state 1,173); early in person 6,526 (state 6,486). Franklin (as of 2026-10-12 00:11): ballots sent 73,312 (state 72,449). Morrow (as of 2026-10-12 16:15): mail returned 92 (state 42); early in person 625 (state 516). Trumbull (as of 2026-10-12 08:43): mail returned 219 (state 214).
